t.E131.agn: In 2013 EFSA set the ADI for patent blue V at 5 mg/kg body weight. At the reported use levels, all age groups remained below this limit.
t.E131.prod: A dye produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E131.regx.0: ADI 5 mg/kg; all groups below the limit at the reported uses.
t.E131.summary: A synthetic, blue dye. It is used in confectionery and desserts; it is also known in medicine as a diagnostic dye.
t.E131.what: Gives a blue colour; together with yellow it produces green shades.
